windows.F0: start of F2r's span F (2009-09-16 23:57:02 UTC, from the F2r Problem)
windows.B_bad_region: seven 12 h windows starting F0 + 0, 6, 12, 18, 24, 30, 36 h (last ends F0 + 48 h = 09-18 23:57)
windows.C_control: two 12 h windows starting F0 + 60 h and F0 + 72 h (09-19 11:57 .. 09-20 11:57; inside the F2s-1 windows that fitted to <= 0.64 m N)

fits.common: F2s-1's fit_window unchanged otherwise: epoch = window start, LOLA positions every 60 s, 1 m weight, start = LOLA state at the window start with E2's K and C_T/S_T, priors F2H on K, C_T, S_T, LM, stop on GN decrement < 1e-3 chi^2 or 10 iterations; GL1800F N=300, DE440, MOON_PA_DE440, rtol/atol 1e-12/1e-13
fits.V0: C_N, S_N fixed at E2's values (as F2s-1)
fits.V1: C_N, S_N also estimated, prior (0, 1e-8 m/s^2) each (F2G's empirical prior), start at E2's values
fits.metric: fit RMS of position minus LOLA in LOLA's R, T, N over the window (N primary)

decision.c0: median V0 N RMS over the two control windows
decision.high: a B window is high if its V0 N RMS >= max(2 x c0, 1.0 m)

location_classes.LOCALIZED: 1..3 high B windows, all contiguous (adjacent starts), and at least 3 B windows not high
location_classes.SPREAD: at least 5 of the 7 B windows high
location_classes.NOT_REPRODUCED: no B window high (the 24 h misfit is absorbed by 12 h windows: a structure longer than 12 h)

empirical_classes.applies: only when at least one B window is high; otherwise V1 is descriptive
empirical_classes.EMP_ABSORBS: median V1 N over the high windows <= max(1.5 x c0, 1.0 m)
empirical_classes.EMP_DOES_NOT_ABSORB: median V1 N over the high windows >= 0.67 x median V0 N over the same windows

decision.F2T_INCONCLUSIVE: more than half of the V0 fits, or more than half of the V1 fits, do not reach the stopping rule, or a control window's V0 N RMS > 1.0 m (control not clean at 12 h)

secondary_descriptive: C_N, S_N per V1 window and their posterior-free size against the SRP acceleration; K and C_T/S_T per window; T RMS pattern
not_changed: no production code; no data, weight, bias or measurement-model change; F2r, F2s, F2s-1 classifications not rewritten; nothing tuned on day 263
